name: jsdotnet-guidelines
description: Three complementary skills for using the JSdotNet Project Guidelines MCP server: learn MCP tools, analyze project gaps, and propose documentation improvements.

skills.title: JSdotNet Project Guidelines MCP
skills.description: Learn how to use the MCP server: tool reference, quick decision guide, common tags, and example workflows.

skills.title: Project Guidelines Gap Analysis
skills.description: Analyze your .NET project structure against established guidelines. Identify missing layers, conventions, and create an improvement plan.

skills.title: Guidelines Feedback Loop
skills.description: Analyze MCP usage logs, identify improvement opportunities, and propose new ADRs or documentation enhancements as GitHub issues.

extensions.description: Provides tools for analyzing MCP logs and creating GitHub issues: analyze_guidelines_usage, draft_guidelines_issue, submit_guidelines_issue.
